book.title: Toto Thovuye Utuniye Jon Le Rorori

content: Jisas na Nikodimos
Jiu lenji randeviva regha idae Nikodimos, iye i mena Parisi e lenji wabwi.
Gougou regha i menawe Jisas na i dagewe iŋa, “Ravavaghare, wo ghareghare ravavaghara ghen u menawe Loi. Kaiwae i vakathana u vakathaŋgina ma lolo regha valɨkaiwae thoŋgo ma weiye Loi.”
Jisas i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Ya dage emunjoru e ghen, ma lolo regha valɨkaiwae na ne i thuwe Loi le ghamba mbaro thoŋgo ma i ghambɨ togha.”
Nikodimos i vaito iŋa, “Thoŋgo lolo kaero i thamatowo, ne ŋgoroŋga iŋa na i virɨ togha? I thovuyewe loloko iyako na tembe i njoghava tɨnae e ŋgamoiye mbowo i ghambɨva mbaŋaiwoniye?”
Jisas i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Ya dage emunjoru e ghen, ma lolo regha ne i ru Loi ele ghamba mbaro tɨne thoŋgo ma i virɨ e mbwa na Nyao Boboma.
Lolo tɨnae na ramae thɨ ghambɨ e yawayawaliye, ko iyemaeŋge thoŋgo Nyao Boboma i vakatha lolo na i ghambɨ togha loloko iyako une ne e yawayawaliye.
Thava gharen i yo kaiwae ya dage e ghen yaŋa, ‘Hu ghambɨ togha,’

ndewendewe i rowo na i uu na i reŋa the valɨvaŋga nuwaiya i reŋawe. U loŋwe laiye, ko iyemaeŋge ma u ghareghare aŋga i uu na i mena o aŋga i uu na i reŋa. Iyako ŋgoreiya gharɨgharɨ thɨ virɨ e Nyao Boboma.”
Nikodimos i vaito iŋa, “Ne ŋgoroŋga na kamwathɨke iyake i yomara?”
Jisas i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Ghen Isirel lenji ravavaghare laghɨye regha ghen, na nuwana ma mba i manjamanjalaŋa bigibigike thiyake?
Ya dage emunjoru e ghen, wo utuŋa budakaiya wo ghareghare na wo woraŋgiya weŋga budakaiya wo thuwe e marame, ko iyemaeŋge ma hu wovatha lama utu.
Thoŋgo ma hu loŋweghathɨŋgo mbaŋa ya utuŋa yambaneke bigibiginiye utuninji, ŋgoroŋga ne huŋa na hu loŋweghathɨŋgo mbaŋa ne ya utuŋa weŋga buruburu bigibiginiye utuninji?
Ma lolo regha mun va i wa e buruburu; mbe ghamberegha eŋge Lolo Nariye, iye i njama e buruburu.
Kaiwae Mosese va i livaira mwata e njamnjam, Lolo Nariye tembene ŋgoreiyeva ne thɨ mwanavairɨ
mbala thavala thɨ loŋweghathɨ ne thɨ vaidiya yawalinji memeghabananiye.”
“Kaiwae Loi emunjoru i gharethovu yambaneke, i vatomwe Nariye ŋgama ghedighedi, thela thoŋgo i loŋweghathɨ mane i mare, ne i vaidiya yawaliye memeghabananiye.
Kaiwae Loi mava i variye Nariye e yambaneke na i wovatharɨtharɨŋaŋgiya gharɨgharɨ na thɨ ghataŋa vɨrɨ, nandere, ko i vamoruŋgi eŋge gharɨgharɨ.

Thela thoŋgo i loŋweghathɨ mane i vaidiya wovatharɨtharɨko iyako, ko thela ma i loŋweghathɨ, wovatharɨtharɨko iyako kaiwae kaero i vaidiya vɨrɨniye, kaiwae ma i loŋweghathɨ Loi Nariye, mbe ghambereghaeŋge, ŋgama ghedighedi.

Thiyake iya kaiwae ne thɨ vaidiya vɨrɨniye: Manjamanjala kaerova i mena e yambaneke, ko iyemaeŋge gharɨgharɨ nuwanjiko i ghaŋgowa momouwo na ma thɨ goruwe manjamanjala kaiwae lenji vakathako mbe tharɨ eŋge.
Thavala thɨ vakatha tharɨ thɨ botewo manjamanjala na mane thɨ mena e manjamanjala, kaiwae thɨ mararu lenji vakathako raraitharɨ i raŋgi e manjamanjala.
Ko thela i vakatha budakaiya emunjoru i mena e manjamanjala, mbala thɨ thuwe wagiyawe le vakathako i vakatha ŋgoreiye Loi le renuwaŋa.”
Jon i utuutu Jisas kaiwae
Iyake e ghereiye Jisas na gharaghambu thɨ rakaraŋgi na thɨ raka Judiya ele valɨvaŋga regha na vethɨ yaku weiyaŋgi gheko na i bapɨtaisoŋgiya gharɨgharɨ.
Jon vambe i bapɨtaisoŋgiva gharɨgharɨ e ghemba regha idae Anon, Salim ghadidiye, kaiwae mbwa va i ghanagha gheko na gharɨgharɨ lemoyo va thɨ rakarakamenawe na i bapɨtaisoŋgi.
Va e mbaŋako iyako Jon mamba i ru e thiyo.
Jon gharaghambu vavana thɨ wogaithɨ weinji Jiu regha thavwithavwi kaiwae, kaiwae iyake thiye Jiu lenji kururu thanavuniye.

Thɨ mena eŋge thɨ utuutu weya Jon thɨŋa, “Ravavaghare, amalama iya mendava weinɨma Jorɨdan valɨvaŋga i vorovoro, iya mendava u utuŋa iye Mesaiya; ee amalaghɨniye i bapɨtaisoŋgiya gharɨgharɨ na gharɨgharɨ lemoyo moli thɨ rakarakawe.”
Jon i gonjogha weŋgi iŋa, “Ma lolo regha ne i wo bigi regha thoŋgo ma Loi i wogiyawe.
Ghemi kaero hu ghareghare iyava yaŋake, ‘Ghino ma Krais ŋgoreiye,’ ko iyemaeŋge Loi va i variyeŋgo na ya viva e ghamwae.

Ragheghe ghɨmoru iye i vaŋgwa ragheghe wevo, ko iyemaeŋge ragheghe ghɨmoru gheu i roroghagha weya ragheghe ghɨmoru weiye ragheghe wevo thɨ vutha, na iye mbe inawe i vandevandeŋa. Mbaŋa i loŋwe ragheghe ghɨmoru ghalɨŋae, i warari laghɨye moli. Ghino lo warari ŋgoreiyako, na lo warariko kaero i mboromboro.
Amalaghɨniye idae mbe i laghɨlaghɨye vara na ghino idaŋgu mbe i didinja vara.”

Iye i mena e buruburu ee i laghɨye kivwalaŋgi gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye. Thela i mena e yambaneke iye ŋgoreiya yambaneke gharɨgharɨniye, na i utu ŋgoreiya rameyambane. Thela i mena e buruburu i laghɨye na i mevoro moli.
I utuŋaŋgiya budakaiya va i thuwe na i loŋwe, ko iyemaeŋge ma lolo regha i wovatha le utuko.
Ko thela thoŋgo i wovatha le utuko, i wovaemuemunjoruŋa na iŋa Loi mbema emunjoru moli.
Kaiwae thela Loi va i variye, i utuŋa Loi ghalɨŋae, kaiwae Loi i giya valawewe Nyao Boboma na ma ele moto.
Ramanda Loi i gharethovu weya Nariye na i bigirawe bigibigike wolaghɨye e nɨmae ghare.
Thela thoŋgo i loŋweghathɨgha Nariye i vaidiya yawaliye memeghabananiye, ko thela thoŋgo i botewo Nariye mane i vaidi yawalɨko iyako, ko iyemaeŋge Loi le ghatemuru laghɨye moli inawe.
